Nairobi (Caasimada Online) – Ugu yaraan 100 qof ayaa dhintay Kenya tobonaan dheeri ahna way indha beeleen ama way xanuunsadeen kadib markii ay cabeen khamri sumeeysan oo loo maleeynayo in uu ku dhex qasmay walxo kiimikaal, sidaana waxa Arbacadii (7-dii May) wariyay AFP.

Xarunta Dhexe ee Qaranka ee Howlgallada Musiibooyinka Kenya ayaa hadal ay soo saartay ku sheegtay in 100 qof ku dhinteen afar degmo, taas oo tiradii hore ee dhimashada kor u qaadday kadib markii ay dhibanayaashu kordheen.

Ilo wareedyo isbitaal ayaa sheegay in tobnaan kale la dawaynayo. Qaar ayaa soo kacay iyaga oo indha la’ kadib markii uu seexiyay cabitaanka, sidaana waxa sheegay saxaafadda maxalliga ah, halka qaar kalena ay si tartiib tartiib ah u luminayaan aragga. Qaar ka mida dhibanayaasha ayaa ka cabanaya calool xanuun ba’an, arag xumo iyo awood yari guud.

“Waxaan isku dayaynaa in ogaanno halkii uu ka yimid khamrigan,” ayay tiri afhayeenka bilayska Zipporah Mboroki. “Waxa socda baaritaanno waxana la qaadi doonaa saamiyo si loo hubiyo halka iyo sida loo diyaariyay.”

Ma cadda in dhimashada oo dhami ay ka timid hal khamri, laakiin dhibanayaasha ayaa ka yimid laba magaalo oo ku dhow Nairobi, iyo sidoo kale qaybo kale oo ku yaal bartamaha iyo bariga dalka. Meelaha qaar khamriga waxa laga gatay baarar ruqsado leh, halka qaar kale laga gatay wadooyinka, ayay sheegeen mas’uuliyiintu.

Khamrada lagu sameeyo degaanka, oo inta badan laga sameeyo galleeyda iyo masagada la qamiiriyay, ayaa waxa aad u isticmaala saboolka, maaddaama ay qiime ahaan aad uga jaban tahay khamriga sida sharciga loo sameeyo loona iibiyo. Qaar ka mida dhibanayaasha ayaa cabitaanka dhigay isbitaallada ka bixiyay lacag gaaraysa $0.50, sida ay sheegayso warbaahinta maxalliga ah.

John Mututho, oo ah madaxa Hay’adda Qaranka Kenya ee u Ololeeynta La-dagaallanka Ku-talax-tagidda Khamriga iyo Maandooriyaha, ayaa sheegay in hay’addiisu ay bilayska kala shaqaynayso sidoo loo soo heli lahaa shabakadda warshadaha iyo qaybiyayaasha khamriga sumaysan.

“Waa in tallaabooyin la qaadaa, dadkuna waa in ay qaataan mas’uuliyaddooda, bilaysku qaban mayo shaqadiisii,” ayuu yiri. “Waa musiibo in ay dhintaan dad intaa tiro le’eg; waxa ay ahayd arrin laga hortagi karay.”
translated_content:
Nairobi (Online Media) - Approximately 100 individuals succumbed to toxic alcohol poisoning in Kenya, allegedly adulterated with industrial chemicals, as reported by AFP on May 7th.

The Southeast Regional Disaster Management Committee confirmed that the incident affected 100 people across four districts, with the death toll rising due to the consumption of the tainted alcohol.

A hospital representative revealed that numerous others are undergoing treatment. Victims exhibited severe symptoms including seizures, vomiting, and profound weakness.

“We are gravely concerned as the casualty count continues to rise,” expressed Zipporah Mboroki, a hospital spokesperson. “The situation demands urgent attention.”

The poisonings occurred primarily in two major cities, Nairobi, and other regions throughout the country. Some victims incurred medical treatment costs as high as $0.50 at hospitals, according to media reports.

John Mututho, director of the Kenya National Authority for the Prohibition of Alcohol and Drug Abuse, stated that they are actively investigating and urged civic responsibility.

“This is a critical matter, and citizens must play their part in preventing further fatalities,” he emphasized. “It is a preventable tragedy.”

Among the accused, who numbered in the dozens, was Xasan Aadan Isaaq Cali, allegedly affiliated with Al-Shabaab, and they were held accountable for the twin bombings that targeted Mogadishu, including the strike on the police and military headquarters. Two separate blasts rocked the capital that day, as reported.

Cali Ibraahim Absuge, a central figure, was given a life sentence.

C/weli Axmed Diiriye was sentenced to six years' imprisonment.

The court also convicted Mukhtaar Maxamuud Xasan Rooble and Cabdul Cabdi Warsame Cali in a landmark ruling.
